```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
```

```{r load_all_mip_tactical, echo=TRUE}
# Load combined tactical MIP table
tactical_path <- "E:/Work/R Projects/GPS/Data_Tactical/ALL_mip_tactical.csv"
all_mip <- read_csv(tactical_path, show_col_types = FALSE, na = c("", "NA", "N/A", "na")) %>%
  rename(any_of(c(
    "scored_mip" = "Goal Scored",
    "conceded_mip" = "Goal Conceded",
    "scored_match" = "scored",
    "conceded_match" = "conceded",
    "total_goals_match" = "total"
  )))

# Replace missing values with 0 for numeric / coded columns
na_to_zero <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x) || is.logical(x)) {
    return(replace_na(x, 0))
  }
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- ifelse(is.na(x), "0", x)
    out[out %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "na")] <- "0"
    return(out)
  }
  replace_na(x, 0)
}

# Normalize one value to 'mm:ss (row-wise to avoid case_when vector recycling issues)
normalize_mmss_one <- function(val) {
  if (is.na(val)) return("'00:00")

  x_chr <- str_remove(trimws(as.character(val)), "^'")
  if (x_chr %in% c("", "0", "00:00", "00:00:00", "NA", "N/A", "na")) return("'00:00")

  if (str_detect(x_chr, "^[0-9]+:[0-9]{1,2}:[0-9]{2}$")) {
    parts <- str_split_fixed(x_chr, ":", 3)
    mm <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(parts[1]))
    ss <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(parts[2]))
    if (!is.na(mm) && !is.na(ss)) {
      return(paste0("'", sprintf("%02d:%02d", mm, ss)))
    }
    return("'00:00")
  }

  if (str_detect(x_chr, "^[0-9]+:[0-9]{1,2}$")) {
    parts <- str_split_fixed(x_chr, ":", 2)
    mm <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(parts[1]))
    ss <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(parts[2]))
    if (!is.na(mm) && !is.na(ss)) {
      return(paste0("'", sprintf("%02d:%02d", mm, ss)))
    }
    return("'00:00")
  }

  if (str_detect(x_chr, "^[0-9]+$")) {
    mm <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(x_chr))
    if (!is.na(mm)) return(paste0("'", sprintf("%02d:00", mm)))
  }

  paste0("'", x_chr)
}

normalize_mmss <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, normalize_mmss_one, character(1))
}

# Columns to leave unchanged (names, clocks, labels, GPS-derived metrics)
keep_cols <- c(
  "player_name", "player_id", "match_id", "MIP_pc1_score",
  "window_start_time", "window_end_time",
  "MIP_TD_m", "MIP_HSR_m", "MIP_AccelDist_m", "MIP_DecelDist_m",
  "mip_start_in_match_mmss", "mip_end_in_match_mmss",
  "score_at _start", "formation", "position",
  "sub_time", "sub_mip_time"
)

bip_cols <- c("IP1", "IP2", "IP3", "OOP1", "OOP2", "OOP3")

all_mip <- all_mip %>%
  mutate(across(-any_of(keep_cols), na_to_zero)) %>%
  mutate(
    bip_time = rowSums(across(all_of(bip_cols))),
    sub_time = normalize_mmss(sub_time),
    sub_mip_time = normalize_mmss(sub_mip_time)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Non-subs (sub = 0): sub_time = '00:00; sub_mip_time = MIP start (normalized to 'mm:ss)
    sub_time = if_else(sub == 0, "'00:00", sub_time),
    sub_mip_time = if_else(sub == 0, normalize_mmss(mip_start_in_match_mmss), sub_mip_time)
  )

# Match-level goals from goals.xlsx (join on date from match_id)
goals_path <- "E:/Work/R Projects/GPS/goals.xlsx"
goals_by_date <- read_excel(goals_path) %>%
  mutate(
    match_date = format(as.Date(date), "%Y-%m-%d"),
    scored_match = as.integer(scored),
    conceded_match = as.integer(conceded),
    total_goals_match = as.integer(total)
  ) %>%
  select(match_date, scored_match, conceded_match, total_goals_match)

goal_cols <- c("scored_match", "conceded_match", "total_goals_match")

all_mip <- all_mip %>%
  select(-any_of(goal_cols)) %>%
  mutate(match_date = substr(match_id, 1, 10)) %>%
  left_join(goals_by_date, by = "match_date") %>%
  select(-match_date)

missing_goal_dates <- all_mip %>%
  filter(if_any(all_of(goal_cols), is.na)) %>%
  distinct(match_date = substr(match_id, 1, 10))
cat("Match dates in ALL_mip_tactical without goals.xlsx entry:", nrow(missing_goal_dates), "\n")
if (nrow(missing_goal_dates) > 0) print(missing_goal_dates)

# Validation: all sub times must be 'mm:ss (leading apostrophe)
mmss_pat <- "^'[0-9]{1,3}:[0-9]{2}$"
bad_sub_time <- all_mip %>%
  filter(!is.na(sub_time), !str_detect(sub_time, mmss_pat))
bad_sub_mip_time <- all_mip %>%
  filter(!is.na(sub_mip_time), !str_detect(sub_mip_time, mmss_pat))
bad_non_sub <- all_mip %>%
  filter(
    sub == 0,
    sub_time != "'00:00" | sub_mip_time != normalize_mmss(mip_start_in_match_mmss)
  )

cat("Rows loaded:", nrow(all_mip), "\n")
cat("sub = 0 but sub_time/sub_mip_time rules failed:", nrow(bad_non_sub), "\n")
if (nrow(bad_non_sub) > 0) {
  print(bad_non_sub %>%
    select(player_name, match_id, sub, sub_time, sub_mip_time, mip_start_in_match_mmss))
}
cat("sub_time formatting check - bad rows:", nrow(bad_sub_time), "\n")
cat("sub_mip_time formatting check - bad rows:", nrow(bad_sub_mip_time), "\n")
if (nrow(bad_sub_time) > 0) print(head(bad_sub_time %>% select(player_name, match_id, sub_time), 10))
if (nrow(bad_sub_mip_time) > 0) print(head(bad_sub_mip_time %>% select(player_name, match_id, sub_mip_time), 10))

# Confirm NA -> 0 conversion
na_counts <- all_mip %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.x))))
na_cols <- na_counts %>% pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "na_count") %>%
  filter(na_count > 0)
cat("Columns still containing NA after cleaning:", nrow(na_cols), "\n")
if (nrow(na_cols) > 0) print(na_cols)

# Persist cleaned data back to source CSV
write_csv(all_mip, tactical_path, na = "")
cat("Saved cleaned data (NA -> 0) to:", tactical_path, "\n")
```
